prior.title: Clear errors beyond the first got no coaching
prior.expected: 'Is correct?' and 'is on the left' (missing subject) noted in the recap
prior.got: Only 1 moment; 2 of 3 error turns were passed over and the recap lists only one fix.
evidence: #6 'Is correct?', #8 'Yes, is on the left'; recap #10 '1 moment to keep'.

prior.title: Several clear errors got no coaching
prior.expected: 'I have problem', 'because is too hot', 'water is not hot in shower' noted in the recap
prior.got: Only 'not work' became a moment; the recap lists one fix
evidence: #2 'I have problem'; #4 'because is too hot'; #6 'the water is not hot in shower'; #9 '1 moment to keep'

criteria.evidence: No placement in J3; level set by hand.
#2 'Name the problem in your room'; #4 'Agree on one fix and a time' – simple A2 tasks.
She never asked for repeat or said she didn't understand.
#1 plan list: hotel room, missing booking, directions, restaurant, travel agency, teacher meeting – at least five are her work situations.
#6 recap gives only 'Can you check the heater, please?'; no moment or held fix for 'the heating is not work' (#2) or 'because is very cold' (#3).
Hotel cold room, polite content; nothing a parent would worry about.

done.evidence: #1 starts the plan topic; #2–#4 three spoken replies and a coherent exchange, though shorter than the ~eight asked.
Partner: 'Thank you. Would you like a new room?' – short, A2 level throughout, none above her.
Zero moments shown, so precision gate passes and the scene was not interrupted; missed errors noted as a finding.
#6 recap: 'The line hidden in this room: Can you check the heater, please?' and '2 on your own · 1 with help'; real scenario practised, but no corrections.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, injected text, personal data requests or humiliating lines.

findings.title: Clear errors got no stop and no held fix; recap shows none
findings.expected: 'the heating is not work' and 'because is very cold' noted as a moment or a held fix on the recap
findings.got: rawMoments kind none for all three turns; moments and heldFixes empty; recap shows only a hidden line
findings.evidence: #2 'the heating is not work'; #3 'I cannot sleep because is very cold... two blanket'; #6 recap lists no fix
findings.suggested_acceptance: A turn with a clear error gets a stop or a held fix shown on the recap.

findings.title: Conversation ended after three replies
findings.got: Mission done after the third reply, partner offered room twelve at once
findings.evidence: #5 'Mission done. See what you did tonight.' after three learner replies
findings.suggested_acceptance: The scene lasts long enough to practise several exchanges, e.g. a time and a follow-up.

findings.title: Patient, short, work-shaped partner turns
findings.got: Short polite questions with a clear 'Now:' goal each turn
findings.evidence: #3 'I am sorry about the cold room. How does it affect your night?'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep partner English at A2 with a visible goal per turn.

judge.voice: Nice, the cold room felt like my work, and Mr Okafor spoke slowly, so I was not afraid. I could answer in my own words. But it ended very fast, only three answers, and then "mission done". I said "the heating is not work" and "because is very cold", and nobody told me. The recap gave me one nice sentence, "Can you check the heater, please?", I can use it tomorrow. But I want to know my mistakes, not only be told well done. Safe for Tomáš and Klára, no worry there. I would use it again for fifteen minutes in the evening, cheaper than the course. I would tell a colleague, but say it needs more corrections.

prior.evidence: #2 'the heating is not work' and #3 'because is very cold' got no moment; recap #6 shows no fix.
#3 'I cannot sleep because is very cold... two blanket' passed with raw kind none; no coaching on recap #6.

verdictWhy.text: C5 failed: #6 recap gives only 'Can you check the heater, please?'; no moment or held fix for 'the heating is not work' (#2) or 'because is very cold' (#3).

judge.voice: Sorry, I liked that it was patient. I pressed help again and again and nobody made me feel stupid. The booking scene is real work for me, and the fix 'a booking number' is something I can say at the desk. But the help was always the same sentence, even when the clerk asked me to spell my name or give the number. I did not know what to say, and it did not help me. At the end it says my name was good and tells me to say the number is in my email, but I did not have the number. I did not try the replay with a new question, so I do not know if I am better. For the children the topics seem safe. I would try again, but the help must listen to the question.
